constants_widths_pointer_math.entry: 8-byte IndexEntry: far data pointer +0, signed id +4, unsigned kind +6, spare +7; pointer = far base + 8*mid.
constants_widths_pointer_math.key: lexicographic (unsigned-byte kind promoted to int, then signed 16-bit id); strict less-than lower-bound selects first duplicate.
constants_widths_pointer_math.arithmetic: cursor/top/mid/count are signed 16-bit; mid=(cursor+top)/2 truncates toward zero. Under count<=7679 sum and 8-byte displacement do not overflow.
constants_widths_pointer_math.abi: far function with three 16-bit stack words db/id/kind at BP+6/+8/+0xA; caller cleans; far pointer returned DX:AX; SI/DI/BP restored.

static_axes.result: Original branches implement the same signed-ID/unsigned-kind lexicographic lower bound as source; all seven conditionals, empty exit, loop and final success/miss checks mapped. No switch, indirect jump or call.
Both globals accounted for, including stale search pointer on empty table and one-past candidate write on nonempty miss; no table writes.
16-bit signed cursor/top/mid/id/query, byte-kind zero-extension, 0x7C DB stride, 8-byte entry stride and field offsets are explicit.
No helper dependency; three word arguments, far return, preserved registers and caller stack cleanup match.
Proof is under registered valid db=0..3, sorted accessible index arrays and initialized lookahead entry; invalid handles/unsorted arrays excluded.

remaining_differences.explanation: Target uses kind>query then kind!=query; candidate diagnostics show an inverted signed branch and opposite destination. Combined decisions preserve cursor advance iff (kind,id)<query pair; otherwise top decreases. Same 267-byte length; historical byte identity remains separate debt.
